inventory.name: [Nopalcyber]Suspicious PowerShell File Download from External Domain

native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [Nopalcyber]Suspicious PowerShell File Download from External Domain
native_rule.s1ql: event.type = "Process Creation" and src.process.name in:anycase ("powershell.exe", "pwsh.exe") and(src.process.cmdline contains:anycase "Invoke-WebRequest" or src.process.cmdline contains:anycase "iwr " or src.process.cmdline contains:anycase "wget " or src.process.cmdline contains:anycase "DownloadFile" or src.process.cmdline contains:anycase "DownloadString") and src.process.cmdline matches ".*https?://[^\\s]+\\.[a-z]{2,}.*" and src.process.netConnOutCount > 0 and!(src.process.cmdline contains:anycase "slackb.com/error") and!(src.process.cmdline contains:anycase "chocolatey") and src.process.user != "NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM"
